description: Attach a custom domain (e.g. app.example.com) to a project's service. Returns the exact DNS record to create at the domain's DNS provider; TLS is issued automatically once DNS resolves.

project.description: Project slug. Optional: defaults to rivtor.json in the working directory, else its folder name.

service.description: Service to route to; default is the project's primary public service.

name: domain_add
title: Add custom domain
